items.title: FATF targets crypto hubs in review of money laundering controls
items.summary: The watchdog has not named the jurisdictions under review. Initial findings on compliance with its crypto standards are due in June 2027.

items.title: Bank of Korea probes financial firms’ exposure to crypto risks
items.summary: The central bank is surveying 31 financial institutions on how a major exchange shutdown, prolonged crypto downturn or losses at another firm could affect their operations.

items.summary: Bitcoin faces mounting quantum security concerns as Ripple secures a US banking charter, USDC gains ground in Europe and VanEck adds BTC to a new ETF.

items.title: NYSE taps Wall Street giant Broadridge to bring shareholder voting to tokenized stocks
items.summary: A key provider of shareholder voting and corporate services on Wall Street, Broadridge will help bring investor rights onchain for the exchange's upcoming venue.

items.title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million drained across 10 chains
items.summary: The Brazilian exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after wallets on at least 10 chains were emptied, days after the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

items.summary: Nearly 70% of the companies initially picked for trading have opted out, while 19 firms including Apple, Tesla and Amazon have no disclosed objection as the 30-day response window nears its end.

items.title: Anthropic swings to third quarter operating loss as compute costs surge ahead of IPO
items.summary: The Claude developer generated $17 billion in quarterly revenue, but higher computing costs resulted in a $567 million operating loss.

items.title: Standard Chartered debuts tokenized deposits in Hong Kong for corporate clients
items.summary: The bank uses Hong Kong's EnsembleTX system to move deposits between participating banks around the clock, settling in central bank money.

items.title: Crypto's Washington playbook is working. Don't abandon it now.
items.summary: Regardless of how the midterm elections unfold or which party secures the presidency in 2028, our industry must adhere to its established playbook, writes Solana Policy Institute’s Colin McLaren.

items.title: Coinbase downgraded at Morgan Stanley; price target slashed 53% on weak earnings outlook
items.summary: Analyst Michael Cyprys cited weak crypto trading activity and doubts about an earnings recovery.

items.title: Tokenization firm tZERO plans to go public in $350 million SPAC deal
items.summary: The digital securities firm plans to list on NYSE American under TZRO early next year after more than a decade building blockchain-based trading infrastructure.

items.title: XRP Ledger set to fix a possible flaw that could have let stablecoin partners print new tokens
items.summary: The fix is on track for Wednesday after validator support briefly dipped and restarted the two-week activation clock. XRP itself is unaffected.

items.summary: The company is starting with $366,000 worth of copper stored in Germany, hoping to build a market for investors to own and trade physical metal onchain.
